feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence from earlier iterations: iteration 8 (wheel_track 0.105 m, mass 0.40 kg, body 0.10 x 0.08 m, kp 3.8, kd 0.65, sensor_size 0.012 m) finished 60/60 with rms_error 0.0056 to 0.0099 m and line_loss_events 0.85 to 1.05 per run. Iteration 7 showed s-bend steering_oscillation at 0.347 once the track narrowed, so damping is now close to its limit. I kept the controller from iteration 8 unchanged so the sensor step is the only variable. For the integration I had to compensate for the fixed left/right motor mismatch with ki 0.15 and for the faster heading response from the narrow track with kd 0.65, and I kept the signal sign-correct with x/0.015 weights. Next race, the change depends on the result. If line_loss_events fall below about 0.85 and rms_error stays at or below 0.01 m, the wider footprint is working: keep sensor_size 0.016 m and, if slalom finishes are below 20/20, try a further track narrowing. If rms_error rises above 0.01 m or s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.36, the footprint is blurring the signal on sharp bends: return sensor_size to 0.012 m. If line_loss_events stay near 1 per run, footprint is not the cause, so widen the outer sensors instead.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events fall below 0.85 and rms_error stays at or below 0.01 m on the slalom and s-bend: keep sensor_size 0.016 m and try wheel_track 0.10 m, since iteration 7 to 8 showed slalom progress rising with each track narrowing while s-bend oscillation rose only to 0.34.

If rms_error rises above 0.01 m or s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.36 with sensor_size 0.016 m: return sensor_size to 0.012 m and keep wheel_track 0.105 m, since iteration 8 at 0.012 m gave s-bend rms_error 0.0058 m and oscillation 0.34.

If line_loss_events stay near 1 per run (iteration 8: 1.0 oval, 0.85 s-bend, 1.05 slalom) with sensor_size 0.016 m: widen the outer sensor spread to x = -0.035 to +0.035 m with 0.0117 m spacing, since iteration 0 (narrow spread) had 2 line losses per slalom run and the outer sensors are the ones losing the tape at bend entries.
